GC Uploader

Drop one or more .SCTimeline exports — a whole day's slate at once is fine. Each game gets checked for missing/duplicate/mismatched tags, cross-checked against the NHL's own final score, and — only if every game in the batch is clean — saved to the database and available as a fresh Excel download.

Drop .SCTimeline file(s) here, or click to browse

Fallback path — upload an already-built GC.xlsx directly (same as this tool has always supported). Prefer the raw timeline tab above when possible, since it adds the extra tagging/NHL-score validation this one doesn't have.

SL Converter

Upload SportLogiq Game File CSVs to generate Hudl Sportscode XML files.

To align data for each period, go to the opening faceoff of the respective period you're importing. At the moment the puck hits the ice, rewind the video one second (Shift + Option + Left Arrow). Align XML to playhead in that spot.

To align shootout data, go to the point in the first shot taken where the puck leaves the stick, rewind 12 seconds, and align to that point.

Note: This is for the default two second pre-roll on faceoff clips. If you change this pre-roll the timing of alignment may have to be adjusted.
